description: This file contains the abstract class HTMLPurifier_Injector which defines the structure and behavior for HTML token injectors within the HTMLPurifier library. It provides methods for preparing injectors, checking environment requirements, navigating tokens, and handling different token types during HTML parsing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector
classes.description: An abstract base class for HTML token injectors that modify or insert tokens during the parsing process, enabling functionalities like auto-paragraphing, smileys, and linkification.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Sets the input token index to a specific position to re-iterate or re-process tokens.

methods.name: getRewind
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the rewind index.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector with configuration and context objects, checking environment requirements.

methods.name: checkNeeded
methods.description: Verifies if the HTML environment supports the needed elements and attributes for this injector.

methods.name: allowsElement
methods.description: Checks if the current context allows a specific HTML element based on the definition.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Advances to the next token in the input tokens array.

methods.name: forwardUntilEndToken
methods.description: Traverses tokens until reaching the end tag of the current node, considering nested structures.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Moves backward to the previous token.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Initializes iteration at the current token position.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Handler invoked for processing text tokens.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handler invoked for processing start or empty tags.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handler invoked for processing end tags, calling notifyEnd.

methods.name: notifyEnd
methods.description: Notification method called after processing an end token; marked as deprecated.
